units.name: hook registration
units.purpose: registers ABBD's hooks with Claude Code
units.responsibility: fixes which events and tool matchers call abbd hook

units.name: plugin and marketplace manifest
units.purpose: publishes ABBD as a Claude Code plugin from this repository
units.responsibility: fixes the marketplace and plugin names and the plugin source path

units.name: project.yaml
units.purpose: records the trusted extraction and verify argv
units.responsibility: fixes project.yaml, which mode on and turn verify run without asking

units.name: change records
units.purpose: is the record of each turn
units.responsibility: fixes CHG frontmatter: request, seeds, impact, intent delta, approvals, rejections, verification and report

units.name: decision records
units.purpose: is the record of each human decision on a grade C change
units.responsibility: fixes ADR frontmatter: subject, decision, question, reason and turn

units.name: extraction JSON
units.purpose: is what every project extraction script and supplement must print
units.responsibility: fixes the units and relations JSON; unknown fields are rejected

units.name: generated files
units.purpose: lets tools and humans read the topology without the CLI
units.responsibility: fixes the generated file names and graph.json, whose watermark tells CURRENT from STALE

units.name: intended topology
units.purpose: is the human-approved topology every gate compares against
units.responsibility: fixes intended.yaml: revision, units with signatures and external consumers, relations

units.name: requirements
units.purpose: keeps each user request verbatim
units.responsibility: fixes the requirement file a turn points to

units.name: verification runs
units.purpose: is the evidence that a turn's verification passed on its tree
units.responsibility: fixes the run record: command, tree, exit code, result and log path

units.name: unit files
units.purpose: is the actual topology as reviewable files
units.responsibility: fixes the unit file frontmatter: anchors, facts with their evidence, relations

units.name: /abbd-mode
units.purpose: runs a pstack playbook inside a gated ABBD turn
units.responsibility: maps playbooks to turn shapes, sequences start, impact, declare, diff, verify and end, holds the PR until SYNCED or CLOSED, and briefs abbd-agent delegates

units.name: /abbd-setup
units.purpose: bootstraps ABBD on a repository without asking the human
units.responsibility: drives the pstack swarm, the extraction script, the supplement and abbd setup, and leaves alignment to the human

units.name: change item key
units.purpose: names one topology change so a human can approve or reject it
units.responsibility: fixes the change kinds and the ID and edge syntax that the CLI, the screen, CHG and ADR files share

units.name: abbd command line
units.purpose: is the command surface humans, skills and the screen call
units.responsibility: fixes the commands, their flags, positional counts, argv passthrough and exit codes 0, 1, 2 and 64

units.name: confirm item key
units.purpose: names one guess in the confirm queue
units.responsibility: fixes the ID.field and edge syntax a human types to confirm or reject a guess

units.name: Claude Code hook protocol
units.purpose: is how Claude Code hands ABBD each session event
units.responsibility: fixes the hook events, the JSON fields read on stdin and the decision shape written on stdout

units.name: screen HTTP
units.purpose: is what the screen page posts to decide
units.responsibility: fixes the routes and the act form: which decisions exist and which fields each reads

units.name: internal/bootstrap
units.purpose: lays the supplement and adopted documents over the script result and writes the setup report
units.responsibility: matches document units to script units by shared anchors, refuses ties, keeps code facts from the script, and renders a byte-stable bootstrap report

units.name: abbd CLI
units.purpose: lets the human and the agent drive ABBD from a terminal and from Claude Code hooks
units.responsibility: parses argv against the command table, runs setup, align, confirm, approve, reject, couple, ingest, mode, status and the turn commands, maps outcomes to exit codes, and republishes .abbd/generated/ only when the inputs hash changes

units.name: internal/confirm
units.purpose: is the queue of agent guesses waiting for a human
units.responsibility: lists pending purposes, responsibilities and relations design units first, names them, and applies confirm and reject

units.name: internal/extract
units.purpose: is the trust boundary where extraction JSON becomes typed units
units.responsibility: validates kinds, names, anchors, unique keys and contract-only signatures, and marks code facts EXTRACTED and stated intent INFERRED

units.name: internal/gitx
units.purpose: reads the few git facts ABBD needs without touching the user's index
units.responsibility: snapshots the working tree as a tree object through a temporary index, diffs snapshots for renames and changed paths, and reports HEAD and the git dir

units.name: PreToolUse guard
units.purpose: stops an agent in an active session from doing a human's step
units.responsibility: splits shell text into simple commands and denies human-only abbd commands, writes under .abbd/, session state, the registered extraction script, and requests to the running screen

units.name: internal/identity
units.purpose: keeps design unit IDs stable across re-extraction
units.responsibility: matches units by kind and two shared anchors or an identical set, mints IDs from the high-water mark, follows renames, records merge candidates, and decides which facts re-extraction may overwrite

units.name: internal/model
units.purpose: is the shared vocabulary of design units and their evidence
units.responsibility: defines Unit, Fact, Relation and Anchor, the origin, verification and confirmation axes, the kinds and their directories, and KIND-NNNN IDs

units.name: internal/screen
units.purpose: shows the human what needs a decision without opening Markdown
units.responsibility: builds a deterministic view of pending C changes, drift, trust badges, the confirm queue and an ID-stable map, and renders the live page and the watermarked generated files

units.name: screen server
units.purpose: gives the human a browser screen for every decision
units.responsibility: listens on loopback only, checks Host, Origin, Sec-Fetch-Site and the per-launch token, and turns each form into one CLI argv run in process

units.name: internal/store
units.purpose: persists all ABBD state as reviewable files under .abbd/ and the git dir
units.responsibility: is the only reader and writer of every .abbd file layout: no-op-if-equal writes, ID high-water minting, the intended revision, input hashes and session mode files

units.name: internal/topology
units.purpose: compares the approved intended topology with the actual one
units.responsibility: owns the five change kinds, the single effect rule (BLOCKED, REALIGN, PROMOTE), phase derivation, and the select, approve and realign folds

units.name: internal/turn
units.purpose: models one unit of agent work under abbd mode
units.responsibility: owns turn states, impact computation, grades A, B and C, approvals and rejections, the declared-versus-actual contrast, and the verification evidence rule
